# 1 Enoch Chapter 62 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 62:1 — 'lift up your horns' — address to the kings

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "lift-up-your-horns if-ye-are-able to-recognize the-Elect-One" | Literal; 'horns' = power/pride (Ge'ez qern) |
| LOGOS | "lift up your horns, if you are able to recognize the Elect One" | Preserves 'horns' as the Ge'ez idiom for power |
| PNEUMA | "lift your heads — if you have the ability to recognize the Elect One" | 'Heads' for 'horns'; PNEUMA substitutes a natural English idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained 'lift up your horns' (EMET/LOGOS). The 'horn' as a symbol of power and pride (cf. Ps 75:4-5; Dan 7-8) is integral to the Enochic critique of worldly power. PNEUMA's 'heads' loses this symbolic dimension entirely.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. Symbolic language preserved.

---

## 62:5 — 'that Son of Man' — the definite article

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "that-Son-of-Man" | Ge'ez wa-walda be'esi with demonstrative/definite article |
| LOGOS | "that Son of Man" | Preserves the definite/demonstrative article |
| PNEUMA | "that Son of Man" | Agrees |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Full convergence. 'That Son of Man' is preserved with the demonstrative article by all three translators. This is critical: the 'that' (Ge'ez wa-) points back to the Son of Man figure introduced in ch. 46:1-4, establishing him as a pre-existent, identified figure — not merely a generic 'human being.'

**Status:** Full convergence. Theologically decisive term.

---

## 62:7 — 'from the beginning the Son of Man was hidden' — pre-existence claim

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "from-the-beginning-the-Son-of-Man was-hidden" | Literal; pre-existence affirmed |
| LOGOS | "from the beginning the Son of Man was hidden" | Preserves the pre-existence claim |
| PNEUMA | "from the very beginning, the Son of Man was hidden" | 'Very beginning' adds slight emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The pre-existence of the Son of Man is one of the most significant theological claims in all of Second Temple literature. The phrase should be rendered clearly and literally. PNEUMA's 'very beginning' is acceptable but adds a word not in the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Pre-existence language preserved.

---

## 62:12 — 'they shall be a spectacle for the righteous' — the reversal of shame

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-be-a-spectacle for-the-righteous and-for-his-elect" | Literal; the Ge'ez re'y = sight, spectacle |
| LOGOS | "they shall be a spectacle for the righteous and for his elect" | Preserves the stark language |
| PNEUMA | "they will become a spectacle for the righteous and for his elect" | 'Become' slightly more dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. 'They shall be a spectacle' is one of the most charged phrases in the Parables — a pointed reversal of Roman amphitheater culture where prisoners and criminals were made 'spectacles' for crowds. The righteous were the ones publicly shamed; here the tables are fully turned. The stark language must not be softened.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Culturally and theologically significant phrase.

---

## 62:14 — eschatological banquet: 'eat and lie down and rise up'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-eat and-lie-down and-rise-up for-ever-and-ever" | Literal; the three activities suggest communal life |
| LOGOS | "they shall eat and lie down and rise up for ever and ever" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "they will eat together, and lie down together, and rise up together — forever and ever" | Adds 'together' three times for communal emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The Ge'ez does not have 'together' explicitly, and adding it three times (PNEUMA) overloads the text. The communal sense is implicit. The formula 'eat and lie down and rise up' describes the full rhythm of human life now enjoyed forever in the presence of the Son of Man.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
